title: EMI Calculator
seoTitle: Free EMI Calculator — Loan EMI Online
description: Calculate the monthly EMI for a loan from principal, interest rate and tenure. See total interest and total amount payable. Instant and private.
intro: Enter the loan amount, annual interest rate and tenure in months or years. The monthly EMI updates instantly along with total interest.
blurb: Calculate monthly EMI, total interest and amount payable for any loan.
howItWorks: Enter the principal amount, yearly interest rate and number of months.
The standard EMI formula is applied instantly in the browser.
See the monthly payment, total interest and total amount you will pay.
examples: A ₹5,00,000 loan at 8.5% for 60 months has an EMI around ₹10,300.
Compare different tenures to see how interest changes.
Use for personal, car or home loan estimates.

faq.a: The standard reducing-balance EMI formula: EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1), where r is the monthly rate.

faq.q: Is this an exact bank calculation?
faq.a: It is a close approximation. Actual bank EMIs may differ slightly due to rounding or additional charges.
